description: Telescopes whose detector temperature is exactly 152.1 K are included, along with those above it.

c.request: Matching each telescope to its observatory by `observstation` (dropping telescopes with no matching observatory) and keeping only telescopes on the high side of a 152.1 cutoff for detector temperature (`detecttempk`), show for each weather profile (`weathprofile`) the average bandwidth usage (`bandusagepct`, ignoring missing values), the number of telescopes, and how far that average sits from the mean of the per-weather-profile averages (the profile's average minus that mean, which ignores missing averages). Return nothing if that mean is missing, and leave all values unrounded. Telescopes whose detector temperature is exactly 152.1 K are included, along with those above it.
c.sql: WITH profile_averages AS (SELECT o.weathprofile, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t INNER JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.detecttempk >= 152.1 GROUP BY o.weathprofile), with_mean AS (SELECT weathprofile, avg_bandwidth_usage, telescope_count, AVG(avg_bandwidth_usage) OVER () AS mean_profile_average FROM profile_averages) SELECT weathprofile, avg_bandwidth_usage, telescope_count, avg_bandwidth_usage - mean_profile_average AS difference_from_mean FROM with_mean WHERE mean_profile_average IS NOT NULL

d.request: Join telescopes to observatories on `observstation`, keeping only matching telescopes with `detecttempk >= 152.1`; for each `weathprofile`, return the unrounded average of nonmissing `bandusagepct`, the telescope count, and that average minus the mean of all nonmissing weather-profile averages, returning no rows if that overall mean is missing.
d.sql: WITH weather_averages AS (SELECT o.weathprofile, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.detecttempk >= 152.1 GROUP BY o.weathprofile), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bandusagepct) AS mean_weather_average FROM weather_averages) SELECT w.weathprofile, w.avg_bandusagepct, w.telescope_count, w.avg_bandusagepct - overall.mean_weather_average AS difference_from_mean FROM weather_averages AS w CROSS JOIN overall WHERE overall.mean_weather_average IS NOT NULL

b.sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT o.weathprofile, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.detecttempk >= 152.1 GROUP BY o.weathprofile), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bandusagepct) AS mean_group_average FROM grouped) SELECT g.weathprofile, g.avg_bandusagepct, g.telescope_count, g.avg_bandusagepct - overall.mean_group_average AS difference_from_mean FROM grouped AS g CROSS JOIN overall WHERE overall.mean_group_average IS NOT NULL
